title: Counit identity of an adjunction mate
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal E,\mathcal F$ be categories [def-nagata-category], with functors $L_1:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $R_1:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$, $L_2:\mathcal E\to\mathcal F$, $R_2:\mathcal F\to\mathcal E$, adjunctions $L_1\dashv R_1$, $L_2\dashv R_2$ with units $\eta_1,\eta_2$ and counits $\varepsilon_1,\varepsilon_2$, and functors $G:\mathcal C\to\mathcal E$, $H:\mathcal D\to\mathcal F$. Let $\alpha:L_2G\to HL_1$ be a natural transformation and let $\beta:GR_1\to R_2H$ be its mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Composition is written right to left. For every $d\in\mathcal D$ one has
$$\varepsilon_{2,Hd}\circ L_2(\beta_d)=H(\varepsilon_{1,d})\circ\alpha_{R_1d}.$$
This identity requires neither the functors nor $\alpha$ nor $\beta$ to be equivalences or isomorphisms.
